verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 72.1 (-9.5% in a day) and momentum is 46: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 1,900 and 86s 4,800. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-21T15:17:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Felix Nmecha 86 Team of the week after its 68% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 270,000 coins. Now 233,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 67.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 6 of 12 so far, averaging +5.6% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Simone Laudehr 88 Base Hero after its 40% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 88,000 coins. Now 57,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 39.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 6 of 12 so far, averaging +5.6% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 1,900 (0.90 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,800 (1.17 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,700 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,500 (1.39 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Gilberto Mora and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Gilberto Mora 87 Future Stars -82.0%; Theo Walcott 90 Hall of FUT: Unleashed -80.8%; James Garner 86 Ultimate Scream -79.0%; Jon Martín 85 Future Stars -78.7%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Michelle Cooper SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 30.6K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
